card.name: Comma before 'refer to' instruction
card.fires_on: The comma that closes an introductory 'For dosing/information about X' phrase, right before a cross-reference such as 'refer to' or 'see'. Seen mostly in dosing sections that point to another drug's prescribing information.

modes.label: Dosing cross-reference
modes.description: Comma after a 'For dosing modifications/instructions for [drug]' phrase, before a pointer to other prescribing information.
modes.example: For dosing modifications for cisplatin, carboplatin, or pembrolizumab<<,>> refer to their prescribing information.

modes.label: Documentation pointer
modes.description: Comma after 'For information on...' in technical documentation, before 'see' a reference page.
modes.example: For information on these doc strings<<,>> see the PythonWin Reference for the function

card.writes: It promotes 'refer', 'reference' and 'see'-type words, so the next word is likely a cross-reference.
card.plain: It fires on the comma after 'For dosing of X' that comes just before 'refer to the prescribing information'.
